# llms-txt-gen

> Generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt from a repository README and docs folder, with a check mode for CI drift. Python package trysac-llms-txt-gen, import name llms_txt_gen, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and what the tests cover
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective and scope
